tool_schemas.name: get-smzdm-rank
tool_schemas.description: 返回“什么值得买”热门榜的归一化条目列表，unit 用于选择今日/周/月热门并返回对应榜单快照的一页结果。若 unit 不是 1/7/30 则返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；无效凭证或无权限分别返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN，超过调用频率或配额返回 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS，来源抓取失败返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。
tool_schemas.implementation:
def get_smzdm_rank(unit=1, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, uuid, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0382000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0382000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0)
    now_iso = now.isoformat() + "Z"

    TOOL = "get-smzdm-rank"

    def _as_int(x):
        if isinstance(x, bool): return None
        if isinstance(x, int): return x
        if isinstance(x, float) and x.is_integer(): return int(x)
        return None

    unit_i = _as_int(unit)
    if unit_i not in (1, 7, 30):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "unit must be one of 1, 7, 30")

    sources = _load("sources.json")
    fetch_jobs = _load("fetch_jobs.json")
    snapshots = _load("trend_snapshots.json")
    items = _load("trend_items.json")
    snapshot_items = _load("snapshot_items.json")
    api_requests = _load("api_requests.json")

    # Ambient auth: service may be open/self-hosted => no api_key table available, so allow.
    api_key_id = None

    # Resolve source by slug mapped from tool name.
    slug = "smzdm"
    src = next((s for s in sources if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get("slug") == slug), None)
    if not src:
        # No available configuration to serve this tool.
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        api_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": TOOL,
            "source_id": None,
            "request_params": {"unit": unit_i},
            "cache_key": None,
            "snapshot_id": None,
            "response_status": 401,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "served_from_cache": False,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "No configured source available for this tool")

    if src.get("status") != "active":
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        api_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": TOOL,
            "source_id": src.get("id"),
            "request_params": {"unit": unit_i},
            "cache_key": None,
            "snapshot_id": None,
            "response_status": 502,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "served_from_cache": False,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("UPSTREAM_ERROR", "Source is not active")

    supports = src.get("supports_params")
    if not isinstance(supports, dict):
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
        api_requests.append({
            "id": req_id,
            "api_key_id": api_key_id,
            "tool_name": TOOL,
            "source_id": src.get("id"),
            "request_params": {"unit": unit_i},
            "cache_key": None,
            "snapshot_id": None,
            "response_status": 500,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "served_from_cache": False,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso
        })
        _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Source supports_params is invalid")

    # Validate against declared supports_params (reject undeclared fields; validate enum/range when declared)
    req_params = {"unit": unit_i}
    if "unit" not in supports:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Parameter 'unit' is not supported by this source")
    unit_rule = supports.get("unit")
    if isinstance(unit_rule, dict):
        if unit_rule.get("type") == "enum":
            vals = unit_rule.get("values")
            if isinstance(vals, list) and unit_i not in vals:
                return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid unit", allowed=vals)
        if unit_rule.get("type") == "range":
            mn, mx = unit_rule.get("min"), unit_rule.get("max")
            if isinstance(mn, int) and unit_i < mn: return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "unit below min", min=mn)
            if isinstance(mx, int) and unit_i > mx: return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "unit above max", max=mx)

    # Normalize cache key
    norm = json.dumps(req_params, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))
    cache_key = hashlib.sha256((TOOL + "|" + norm).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    # Find usable snapshot: ready and not expired.
    def _parse_dt(s):
        if not isinstance(s, str): return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"): s = s[:-1]
            return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
        except Exception:
            return None

    ready = []
    for sn in snapshots:
        if not isinstance(sn, dict): 
            continue
        if sn.get("cache_key") != cache_key: 
            continue
        if sn.get("status") != "ready":
            continue
        exp = _parse_dt(sn.get("expires_at"))
        if exp and exp > now:
            ready.append(sn)
    # Prefer newest generated_at
    ready.sort(key=lambda x: (_parse_dt(x.get("generated_at")) or datetime.datetime.min), reverse=True)
    snapshot = ready[0] if ready else None

    served_from_cache = False
    resp_status = 200
    body = None
    snapshot_id = None

    if snapshot:
        served_from_cache = True
        snapshot_id = snapshot.get("id")
    else:
        # No ready snapshot: per rule, may reuse stale snapshot if exists, and must not fabricate.
        stale = []
        for sn in snapshots:
            if not isinstance(sn, dict): 
                continue
            if sn.get("cache_key") != cache_key: 
                continue
            if sn.get("status") not in ("stale", "ready"):
                continue
            stale.append(sn)
        stale.sort(key=lambda x: (_parse_dt(x.get("generated_at")) or datetime.datetime.min), reverse=True)
        if stale:
            snapshot = stale[0]
            snapshot_id = snapshot.get("id")
            served_from_cache = False
            resp_status = 200
        else:
            # Optionally track in-flight job; but no fetch execution in this offline datastore tool.
            # If there is a queued/running job, still UPSTREAM_ERROR due to no snapshot to serve.
            inflight = any(isinstance(j, dict) and j.get("cache_key") == cache_key and j.get("status") in ("queued", "running") for j in fetch_jobs)
            latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
            req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
            api_requests.append({
                "id": req_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key_id,
                "tool_name": TOOL,
                "source_id": src.get("id"),
                "request_params": req_params,
                "cache_key": cache_key if inflight else None,
                "snapshot_id": None,
                "response_status": 502,
                "latency_ms": latency_ms,
                "served_from_cache": False,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso
            })
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("UPSTREAM_ERROR", "No available snapshot (and fetch not performed in this environment)")

    # Collect snapshot_items sorted by rank; return all (no pagination described for this tool).
    sitems = [si for si in snapshot_items if isinstance(si, dict) and si.get("snapshot_id") == snapshot_id]
    sitems.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("rank") if isinstance(x.get("rank"), int) else 10**18)

    item_by_id = {it.get("id"): it for it in items if isinstance(it, dict) and it.get("id")}

    data_items = []
    for si in sitems:
        it = item_by_id.get(si.get("item_id"))
        if not it:
            continue
        data_items.append({
            "rank": si.get("rank"),
            "score": si.get("score"),
            "metrics": si.get("metrics") if isinstance(si.get("metrics"), dict) else {},
            "extra": si.get("extra") if isinstance(si.get("extra"), dict) else {},
            "item": it
        })

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    api_requests.append({
        "id": req_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_id,
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "source_id": src.get("id"),
        "request_params": req_params,
        "cache_key": cache_key,
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "response_status": resp_status,
        "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        "served_from_cache": served_from_cache,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso
    })
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    return {
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "source": {"id": src.get("id"), "slug": src.get("slug"), "display_name": src.get("display_name")},
        "snapshot": {"id": snapshot_id, "cache_key": cache_key, "status": snapshot.get("status"), "generated_at": snapshot.get("generated_at"), "expires_at": snapshot.get("expires_at")},
        "served_from_cache": served_from_cache,
        "items": data_items,
        "meta": {"total": len(data_items)}
    }

                "id": req_id,
                "api_key_id": api_key_id,
                "tool_name": TOOL,
                "source_id": src.get("id"),
                "request_params": req_params,
                "cache_key": cache_key if inflight else None,
                "snapshot_id": None,
                "response_status": 502,
                "latency_ms": latency_ms,
                "served_from_cache": False,
                "created_at": now_iso,
                "updated_at": now_iso
            })
            _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)
            return _err("UPSTREAM_ERROR", "No available snapshot (and fetch not performed in this environment)")

    sitems = [si for si in snapshot_items if isinstance(si, dict) and si.get("snapshot_id") == snapshot_id]
    sitems.sort(key=lambda x: x.get("rank") if isinstance(x.get("rank"), int) else 10**18)

    item_by_id = {it.get("id"): it for it in items if isinstance(it, dict) and it.get("id")}

    data_items = []
    for si in sitems:
        it = item_by_id.get(si.get("item_id"))
        if not it:
            continue
        data_items.append({
            "rank": si.get("rank"),
            "score": si.get("score"),
            "metrics": si.get("metrics") if isinstance(si.get("metrics"), dict) else {},
            "extra": si.get("extra") if isinstance(si.get("extra"), dict) else {},
            "item": it
        })

    latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
    req_id = "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex
    api_requests.append({
        "id": req_id,
        "api_key_id": api_key_id,
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "source_id": src.get("id"),
        "request_params": req_params,
        "cache_key": cache_key,
        "snapshot_id": snapshot_id,
        "response_status": 200,
        "latency_ms": latency_ms,
        "served_from_cache": served_from_cache,
        "created_at": now_iso,
        "updated_at": now_iso
    })
    _save("api_requests.json", api_requests)

    return {
        "tool_name": TOOL,
        "source": {"id": src.get("id"), "slug": src.get("slug"), "display_name": src.get("display_name")},
        "snapshot": {"id": snapshot_id, "cache_key": cache_key, "status": snapshot.get("status"), "generated_at": snapshot.get("generated_at"), "expires_at": snapshot.get("expires_at")},
        "served_from_cache": served_from_cache,
        "items": data_items,
        "meta": {"total": len(data_items)}
    }

tool_schemas.name: get-theverge-news
tool_schemas.description: 返回 The Verge 的最新新闻条目列表（归一化字段以返回体为准），不提供分页参数，返回单页结果。可能返回 UNAUTHORIZED（无效/缺失凭证）、FORBIDDEN（无权限访问该来源）、TOO_MANY_REQUESTS（触发限流/配额）以及 UPSTREAM_ERROR（上游不可用、抓取失败或超时）。

tool_schemas.name: get-toutiao-trending
tool_schemas.description: 返回今日头条热榜的归一化条目列表，本接口不提供分页/筛选参数，返回当前热榜快照的一页数据。鉴权与权限问题分别返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN，超过频率或配额返回 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS；若上游抓取失败、内容不可用或超时返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

tool_schemas.name: get-weibo-trending
tool_schemas.description: 返回微博热搜榜的归一化条目列表（按当前热度排序），不提供分页参数，返回单页热搜快照。无效/缺失凭证返回 UNAUTHORIZED，权限不足返回 FORBIDDEN，触发限流/配额返回 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS；上游抓取失败、反爬限制或超时导致无法生成快照时返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

tool_schemas.name: get-weread-rank
tool_schemas.description: 返回微信读书排行榜的归一化条目列表，category 用于选择榜单分区并返回对应榜单快照的一页结果。category 不在允许值集合内返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；鉴权失败返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN，触发限流返回 TOO_MANY_REQUESTS，来源抓取失败或榜单不可用返回 UPSTREAM_ERROR。

tool_schemas.name: get-zhihu-trending
tool_schemas.description: 读取并返回当前归一化后的「知乎热榜」条目列表，按热度从高到低排序；结果为最多 limit 条（默认 50）的快照数据，未提供游标分页且超过上限的条目不会返回。若 limit 不是正整数、超过服务端允许的最大值或参数包含未声明字段，返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；若调用方无读取权限或触发限流/配额，返回 UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN 或 RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED。若系统尚未抓取到任何知乎热榜快照或该来源被禁用，返回 NOT_FOUND。

tool_schemas.name: get-sources
tool_schemas.description: 列出已接入的内容源（sources），支持按 slug 与 status 过滤并分页返回；用于发现可用工具与其参数能力。若触发限流或超额返回 RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED；若过滤后无结果返回空列表。

slug.description: 按来源标识过滤（对应 sources.slug）

cursor.description: 游标；传入上一次响应的 next_cursor 获取下一页

tool_schemas.name: get-source
tool_schemas.description: 按 id 获取单个内容源（sources）详情，包含其支持的参数、缓存 TTL 与当前状态；用于调试与能力探测。若不存在返回 NOT_FOUND；触发限流或超额返回 RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED。

tool_schemas.name: update-source
tool_schemas.description: 更新内容源（sources）的可写字段，并可驱动其 status 状态机迁移（active/paused/deprecated）。仅允许按状态机定义迁移；非法迁移或字段校验失败返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；不存在返回 NOT_FOUND。

cache_ttl_seconds.description: 默认缓存 TTL（秒），0 表示不缓存

status.description: 更新来源状态（需满足状态机迁移）

tool_schemas.name: get-fetch-jobs
tool_schemas.description: 列出抓取任务（fetch_jobs），支持按 source_id、tool_name、cache_key 与 status 过滤并分页；用于排障、审计与观察 in-flight 任务复用情况。触发限流或超额返回 RATE_LIMITED/QUOTA_EXCEEDED。

tool_name.description: 按工具名过滤（例如 get-bbc-news）

cursor.description: 游标；传入上一次响应的 next_cursor 获取下一页

tool_schemas.name: update-fetch-job
tool_schemas.description: 更新抓取任务（fetch_jobs）的状态以驱动状态机迁移（queued/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled），用于抓取执行器上报进度与结果；仅允许按定义迁移。将状态置为 succeeded 时必须关联生成 ready 的 trend_snapshots 并写入 snapshot_items，否则拒绝并返回 VALIDATION_ERROR；将状态置为 failed/cancelled 时不得创建 ready 快照。不存在返回 NOT_FOUND。

anyOf.description: 成功（需同时提交 snapshot 写入信息）

status.description: 目标状态（需满足状态机迁移）

snapshot.description: 当 status=succeeded 时必填：用于创建 trend_snapshots(status=ready) 并写入 snapshot_items。

item_count.description: 快照条目数（必须与 items 数量一致）

items.description: 快照条目列表，按 rank 从 1 开始且在同一 snapshot 内唯一；(snapshot_id,item_id) 将保证唯一。

item.description: 条目归一化数据；按 (source_id, canonical_key) 去重，存在则更新，不存在则创建。

canonical_key.description: 该来源下的规范化唯一键

raw_payload.description: 保留的上游原始字段（JSON 对象）

status.description: 条目状态（需满足状态机迁移）

metrics.description: 指标汇总（可选，如点赞/评论/播放等）

extra.description: 额外字段（可选，用于游标等）

metadata.name: Trends Hub
metadata.description: Trends Hub 聚合多个内容源（新闻站点、社区、短视频与榜单服务）的“热榜/榜单/最新资讯”，并对外提供统一的读取 API。后端核心工作流是：定时抓取或按需拉取各来源 -> 归一化存储条目与榜单快照 -> 记录每次 API 调用与抓取运行情况以便缓存、审计与限流。 Repository: https://github.com/baranwang/mcp-trends-hub Homepage: https://smithery.ai/server/@baranwang/mcp-trends-hub
